text:
Type: ceramic planter with wood stand
Use: holding an indoor plant; on the floor beside a sofa or in a corner; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, retro, bohemian
Materials: glazed speckled ceramic, natural bamboo stand
Colors: warm red, orange, peach, terracotta, light natural wood
Shape: cylindrical pot with wide horizontal stripes, raised on a low cross-shaped stand with arched legs, medium size, sturdy
Feel: warm, cheerful, playful
Goes with: light wood, white or cream walls, warm textiles; mid-century or bohemian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Ceramic and Bamboo Planter Flower Pot with Stand,14.5"H, Red and Orange
product.description: Eye-popping colors and a bamboo stand make this planter a true style standout, with or without an added house plant. Each is fired with reactive glaze and hand-painted, so no two are exactly alike. It's ideal for any room needing a bold style boost. 10.6"D x 10.6"W x 14.5"H Designed to hold house plants; does not have drainage holes Ceramic stoneware with separate bamboo stand Reactive glazing and hand-painting means no two are exactly alike in pattern and color
